items.title: What is the verified catalog-readiness position?
assumptions: A source reachability observation is not counted as factual verification.
The 50 Phase 3 records remain pending until a reviewer confirms named fields against an authoritative source.

source.label: YouNew governed verification artifacts

metricDefinitions.label: Confirmed current
metricDefinitions.definition: Confirmed current counts records whose named facts were reviewed against a recorded authoritative source, not records whose URL merely responded.

metricDefinitions.label: Pending factual review
metricDefinitions.definition: Pending factual review counts records that still require a human fact comparison before their freshness date can change.

caveats: The production data-health gate still reports 170 outdated records in the effective published Amsterdam release.

evidenceFlow.title: Queue reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: The audited baseline of 415 records reconciles to 5 confirmed current records and 410 pending factual reviews.

evidenceFlow.title: Phase 3 status check
evidenceFlow.detail: All 50 newly prioritized records are explicitly marked awaiting_fact_review.

rows.metric: Published outdated records blocking data health

preview.note: Aggregate reconciliation recorded by the local Phase 3 pipeline.

items.title: How much of the 30-company partner wave is ready?
assumptions: A public contact page does not establish consent or another lawful basis for direct marketing.
No company is marked ready for contact without both an identity review and a separately documented lawful outreach decision.

source.label: YouNew partner verification wave

metricDefinitions.label: Verified identity
metricDefinitions.definition: Verified identity counts supplied companies whose name and business identity were observed on the supplied official site.

metricDefinitions.label: Ready for contact
metricDefinitions.definition: Ready for contact requires an approved public business channel and a documented lawful outreach basis; none were established in this local phase.

caveats: Three company identities and thirteen business contact routes still need manual review.

evidenceFlow.title: Identity coverage
evidenceFlow.detail: The bounded recheck observed matching identity evidence for 27 of 30 supplied companies.

evidenceFlow.title: Outreach status
evidenceFlow.detail: The tracker records zero sent, replied, interested or registered companies.

preview.note: Aggregate status only; direct contact identifiers are deliberately excluded.

items.title: Which external rules shape launch and outreach?

queries.summary: Google documents the requirements for localized alternates, canonical selection, sitemap submission and indexing review used in the local Search Console runbook.

source.label: Google Search documentation
caveats: The local checks establish package correctness; Search Console submission and production indexing require an authorized live-site action after launch approval.

queries.summary: Dutch regulator guidance requires a lawful basis for direct marketing and treats public availability of contact details as distinct from marketing permission.

source.label: Dutch regulator guidance
caveats: The local outreach drafts are preparation only and do not constitute legal advice or authorization to send.
